facts.claim: The CHC 1915(c) waiver application estimates the program's served population at roughly 483,000.
facts.quote: CHC serves an estimated 483,000 individuals.
facts.title: Community HealthChoices 1915(c) waiver application (main module)

facts.claim: CMS approved the CHC 1915(b) managed-care waiver for a set multi-year window.
facts.quote: approved by CMS for the time period of January 1, 2023 through December 31,
facts.title: Community HealthChoices 1915(c) waiver application (main module)

facts.claim: OLTL administers CHC as a capitated managed-care program within Medicaid.
facts.quote: a capitated Medicaid managed care program called Community HealthChoices (CHC)
facts.title: Office of Long-Term Living

facts.claim: CHC LTSS is not an entitlement, so a waitlist forms when participant slots are full.
facts.quote: LTSS is not an entitlement; there are a limited number of participant enrollment slots
facts.title: Pennsylvania Medicaid Community HealthChoices Program

facts.claim: The CHC waiver's Appendix B projected unduplicated participants for Year 2 (FY 2016-17), a historical planning figure rather than current enrollment.
facts.title: Appendix B: Participant Access and Eligibility
facts.as_of: Waiver application dated 2026-01-28 (table covers FY 2015-16 to 2019-20)

facts.claim: The CHC re-procurement was paused, and the program keeps running under current MCOs until further notice.
facts.value: RFA on hold; current MCOs continue
facts.quote: The CHC program will continue to operate under the current Managed Care Organizations (MCO) until further notice.
facts.title: OLTL Updates, Medical Assistance Advisory Committee presentation

facts.claim: Most people receiving OLTL home and community-based services are enrolled in the CHC waiver rather than the OBRA waiver.
facts.quote: Most people getting home and community-based services from an OLTL waiver are in the CHC waiver.
facts.title: Accessing the CHC Waiver (Eligibility Guide)

facts.claim: CHC covers adults 21 and older with physical disabilities, plus dual-eligible people.
facts.value: Age 21+ with physical disability or dual eligibility
facts.quote: individuals 21 or older with physical disabilities
facts.title: Apply for Community HealthChoices (CHC)

facts.claim: CMS lists the renewed PA OBRA waiver as approved in June 2026, effective July 1, 2026, and running to June 2031.
facts.title: PA OBRA Waiver (0235.R07.00)

facts.claim: The OBRA renewal lengthens the complaint resolution window for the fee-for-service waiver from 45 to 60 days to meet a CMS access rule.
facts.quote: update the timeframe to resolve a complaint from 45 to 60 days
facts.title: 2026 OBRA Waiver Amendment (effective July 1, 2026)

facts.claim: Appendix J (prior waiver version) estimated about 683 unduplicated OBRA participants.
facts.quote: Total Estimated Unduplicated Participants: 683
facts.title: Appendix J: Waiver PA.0235.R06.08

facts.claim: DHS revised the OBRA participant projections downward because fewer people remain on OBRA after CHC rollout.
facts.quote: to reflect fewer overall participants in the OBRA waiver after the implementation of CHC
facts.title: Changes to the OBRA Waiver Effective 7/1/2026 (Renewal)

facts.claim: Service coordination entities under OBRA must keep a waiting list for services as needed.
facts.value: Waitlist kept by service coordination entities
facts.quote: Maintain a waiting list for services as necessary
facts.title: Changes to the OBRA Waiver Effective 7/1/2026 (Renewal)

facts.claim: An older advocacy analysis reported that the OBRA waiver had no waiting list; this is dated and may be outdated.
facts.quote: The OBRA Waiver does not currently have a waiting list.
facts.title: Medicaid Waivers for ID or Autism

facts.claim: The Consolidated Waiver for individuals with intellectual disability, autism, or developmental disability has an amendment effective January 1, 2026.
facts.quote: Effective Date: January 1, 2026
facts.title: Consolidated Waiver

facts.claim: A secondary listing reports about 11,600 people with developmental disabilities and about 980 with autism on the waiting list, mostly adults.
facts.quote: 11,624 people with developmental disabilities and 980 with autism
facts.title: Pennsylvania - Kids' Waivers

facts.claim: A secondary source reports 14,647 people on the Pennsylvania Medicaid waiver waiting list, with no date given.
facts.quote: There are 14,647 people on the Medicaid Waiver waiting list in Pennsylvania.
facts.title: Pennsylvania Medicaid Waiver

facts.claim: The state's official aging office cites more than 2.5 million Pennsylvanians aged 65 and older based on the 2020 Census.
facts.quote: with more than 2.5 million of those residents being aged 65 and older
facts.title: PA Is a Top Place to Retire

facts.claim: Federal Census Bureau estimates released June 25, 2026 put Pennsylvania's 65+ population near 2.8 million.
facts.quote: The federal agency estimates about 2.8 million Keystone State residents are 65 or older
facts.title: Pa. sees growth in over-65 residents, but overall population stagnates

facts.claim: State officials project that by 2030 about one in three Pennsylvanians will be over age 60.
facts.quote: By 2030, one in three commonwealth residents are projected to be over age 60
facts.title: Pa. sees growth in over-65 residents, but overall population stagnates

facts.claim: About 2.67 million Pennsylvanians were 65 or older in 2024, per a secondary data site.
facts.quote: About 2.67 million Pennsylvania residents were aged 65 and older in 2024.
facts.title: How many people live in Pennsylvania?

facts.claim: The 2026 HealthChoices agreement draft is still awaiting Commonwealth signatures and CMS approval.
facts.quote: pending Commonwealth signatures and CMS approval
facts.title: Publications - Physical HealthChoices
